6123.title: Background tasks lose their terminal event on owner exit
6123.rootCauseOneLine: Runtime shutdown and provider detachment discard pending background work without emitting terminal task events.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — directionally addresses root cause
prReviews.topFinding: Adds owner-exit settlements; branch not run. Existing open PR precludes a duplicate fix.

6123.proposedFix: Retain task payloads and emit idempotent terminal events on confirmed owner exit before daemon event flushing; separately handle provider CLI stream end.
6123.caveats: Complete authored test and exact relevant output are inline in the HTML. Both trusted checkouts fail both cases. No live machine suspension, Claude CLI, production timer or resume history was tested. Raw evidence remains local as required by the reports repository.
